plan.notes: Source: official Chapman University 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog (archived), 'Biological Sciences, B.S. Suggested 4-Year Plan (2024)'. Following the established Chapman seed convention, only major-specific courses from the suggested plan are modeled (GE and free electives are selected by the student around this plan); the catalog requires a minimum of 120 credits to graduate and 71 major-specific credits for the B.S. Courses marked * may be waived with appropriate test scores. Biology/Area of Study electives (3-4 cr) modeled at 3 cr as choice slots; the catalog requires biology electives to total at least 24 credits with 16 lab-based. YEAR 1 SPRING DISCREPANCY: the six listed courses sum to 12 credits but the plan header says 14; modeled as listed. BIOL 498 (capstone) is listed in both Year 4 Fall and Spring with a note that it may be taken in either; modeled once in Fall. Prerequisites are not listed on the plan; see the catalog.
